title: The password
starting_code:
# The secret word is ambrel
# Stand beside the gate and say it
hints: First move right until you are next to the gate.
Use the `say` method with the string "ambrel".
After the gate opens, move two steps to the right. This lets you walk through it.
intro: An older pupil told me the secret word! It is ambrel. Stand right beside the gate and say it.
outro: The gate opened! Arvelia is waiting for us on the other side.
learned: Now you know that a word in quotes, which programmers call a string, can open a door.
